values.description: Base URL of the API. Change to https://localhost:5001 when running outside Docker.
API key from ApiKeys.Keys[0] in appsettings.json. Used as X-Api-Key header.
Symmetric signing key from Jwt.SigningKey in appsettings.json. Used to build HS256 JWTs in the JWT auth test.
JWT issuer claim. Must match Jwt.Issuer in appsettings.json.
JWT audience claim. Must match Jwt.Audience in appsettings.json.
